title: Least Privilege & Periodic Access Recertification
description: Authorized institutions must enforce least-privilege access across core financial ledgers and conduct periodic entitlement recertification to prevent privilege creep across departments.
remediation_steps: Revoke uncertified cross-department entitlements exceeding role baseline.
Enforce automated 90-day IAM access recertification workflows signed off by line managers.
Implement role-based entitlement ceilings in the Production IAM Console.

title: Segregation of Duties (SoD) in Payment & Ledger Operations
description: Conflicting duties such as payment initiation and approval, or software development and production deployment, must be strictly segregated across independent personnel.
remediation_steps: Block dual-role entitlement assignments via preventive SoD policy rules in IAM.
Require independent second-line approval for SWIFT Payment Gateway and Core Portfolio Ledger transactions.
Audit all emergency break-glass overrides within 24 hours.

title: Formal Production Change Management & Ticket Traceability
description: All configuration, schema, and IAM policy changes in production systems must be backed by an approved ITSM change ticket, peer review, and rollback plan.
remediation_steps: Enforce CI/CD and IAM pipeline gates requiring a valid approved ITSM change ticket ID.
Revert unauthorized production policy modifications and verify configuration checksums.
Conduct post-incident review with IT Operations and Change Advisory Board.

title: Sensitive Client & Financial Data Exfiltration Prevention
description: Bulk exports of customer KYC records, portfolio holdings, or treasury positions outside business hours require DLP inspection, business justification, and automated alerting.
remediation_steps: Throttle bulk query exports on Client KYC Vault and Core Portfolio Ledger outside 08:00-20:00 HKT.
Require step-up MFA and manager pre-authorization for exports exceeding peer-group baseline.
Inspect endpoint DLP logs and quarantine anomalous export destinations.

title: Dormant Account Lifecycle & Contractor Credential Deprovisioning
description: Dormant, terminated, or inactive contractor accounts must be automatically suspended after 30 days of inactivity and monitored for unauthorized reactivation.
remediation_steps: Disable accounts exceeding 30 days of inactivity automatically via HR-to-IAM lifecycle sync.
Rotate all shared or contractor service credentials and revoke active session tokens.
Place reactivated dormant accounts under 14-day heightened SIEM watch.

title: Third-Party Cloud & Unapproved External AI Endpoint Governance
description: Transmission of proprietary financial models or confidential client data to unapproved external generative AI APIs violates third-party outsourcing and data residency controls.
remediation_steps: Block egress to unapproved external LLM endpoints at the corporate CASB/proxy layer.
Provision an approved internal enterprise AI gateway with PII redaction and audit logging.
Conduct mandatory AI acceptable-use retraining for affected departments.

title: Access Control Policy & Need-to-Know Enforcement
description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and associated assets shall be established based on business and information security requirements.
remediation_steps: Align IAM entitlement matrices with departmental job-function catalogs.
Review cross-departmental access grants quarterly with asset owners.

title: Access Rights Provisioning, Review & Revocation
description: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization's access control topic-specific policy.
remediation_steps: Automate deprovisioning triggers upon role transfer or project offboarding.
Maintain immutable evidence logs of quarterly access recertification campaigns.

title: Privileged Access Rights & Elevated Session Governance
description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed through a Privileged Access Management (PAM) vault with just-in-time elevation.
remediation_steps: Migrate standing administrative privileges to Just-In-Time (JIT) PAM checkout.
Enable full session recording for Production IAM Console and SWIFT Payment Gateway.

title: Data Leakage Prevention (DLP)
description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.
remediation_steps: Deploy content-aware DLP rules detecting KYC IDs, account numbers, and portfolio CSVs.
Enforce encryption and watermarking on authorized regulatory data exports.

title: Immutable Event Logging & Anomaly Correlation
description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed to detect anomalous authentication and access behavior.
remediation_steps: Forward all IAM, database, and AI gateway telemetry to tamper-evident WORM log storage.
Tune behavioral anomaly thresholds against peer-group baselines to reduce alert fatigue.

title: Change Management for Information Processing Facilities
description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to formal change management procedures including impact assessment and authorization.
remediation_steps: Require dual-control verification linking Git/IaC commits to approved ServiceNow/Jira change tickets.
Block direct console edits in production except under audited emergency break-glass.

title: Segregation of Conflicting Duties
description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of assets.
remediation_steps: Enforce maker-checker separation across financial ledger postings and IAM role approvals.
Run weekly automated SoD conflict matrix scans across all 120+ staff accounts.

title: Use of Cryptography & Tokenization for Data in Transit
description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management and data tokenization before external processing, shall be defined and implemented.
remediation_steps: Apply automated PII tokenization before any internal analytics dataset leaves secure enclaves.
Enforce TLS 1.3 and mutual authentication for internal data lake APIs.

title: AI Governance Accountability & Shadow AI Inventory
description: The characteristics and use of third-party AI systems and external LLM endpoints are inventoried, approved, and governed under organizational risk tolerances.
remediation_steps: Maintain a centralized registry of approved foundation models and enterprise AI sandboxes.
Configure DNS/proxy alerts for unauthorized external AI API domains.

title: Data Privacy & Confidentiality Mapping in AI Workflows
description: Organizational risk tolerances and client confidentiality boundaries are mapped prior to feeding corporate datasets into generative or predictive AI pipelines.
remediation_steps: Implement pre-prompt PII/client-ID scrubbing middleware in the AI Research Sandbox.
Classify all datasets by sensitivity tier before granting AI Sandbox read permissions.

title: Continuous Evaluation of Automated Detection & Alert Fatigue
description: AI-based security and audit monitoring systems are regularly evaluated for precision, recall, false-positive burden, and error archetypes across business units.
remediation_steps: Track quarterly PR-AUC and false-positive rate per department for audit anomaly models.
Feed human auditor triage decisions back into threshold calibration reviews.

title: Human-in-the-Loop Oversight & Auditable Escalation
description: Mechanisms are maintained to supersede, disengage, or escalate AI-flagged governance alerts through documented human-in-the-loop review workflows.
remediation_steps: Preserve immutable audit review logs capturing reviewer identity, rationale, and disposition.
Define SLA escalation paths for Critical (>=80) findings to Information Security & Compliance.
